import numpy as np

# Camera 15 pose:
px, py = 0.933, 3.616
th = np.radians(60)

# Stool in obs15:
# Front-left leg at c=110, r=425
# Front-right leg at c=150, r=401
# Back-left leg at c=85, r=410
# Back-right leg at c=128, r=389
# Average front/back leg row:
# Center row of stool contact: (425 + 401 + 410 + 389) / 4 = 406.25
v_stool = 406.25
u_stool = (110 + 150 + 85 + 128) / 4 = 118.25

Z_c = 256 * 1.55 / (v_stool - 256)
X_c = (u_stool - 256) * 1.55 / (v_stool - 256)

world_x = px + Z_c * np.sin(th) + X_c * np.cos(th)
world_y = py + Z_c * np.cos(th) - X_c * np.sin(th)
print(f'Refined Stool World Pos: x = {world_x:.3f}, y = {world_y:.3f}')
"
